#!/usr/bin/python
from BaseHTTPServer import HTTPServer, BaseHTTPRequestHandler

class InventoryHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path == '/healthz':
            body = '{"service":"inventory-api","status":"ok"}\n'
            code = 200
        elif self.path == '/' or self.path == '/inventory':
            body = '{"service":"inventory-api","inventory":[]}\n'
            code = 200
        else:
            body = '{"error":"not found"}\n'
            code = 404
        self.send_response(code)
        self.send_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
        self.send_header('Content-Length', str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        pass

HTTPServer(('0.0.0.0', 8080), InventoryHandler).serve_forever()

#!/bin/sh
### BEGIN INIT INFO
# Provides:          inventory-api
# Required-Start:    $remote_fs $network
# Required-Stop:     $remote_fs $network
# Default-Start:     2 3 4 5
# Default-Stop:      0 1 6
# Short-Description: Inventory API service
### END INIT INFO

DAEMON=/usr/bin/python
APP=/usr/local/sbin/inventory-api.py
NAME=inventory-api
PIDFILE=/var/run/$NAME.pid
USER=inventory-api

case "$1" in
  start)
    if [ -f "$PIDFILE" ] && kill -0 "$(cat "$PIDFILE")" 2>/dev/null; then
      exit 0
    fi
    rm -f "$PIDFILE"
    start-stop-daemon --start --quiet --background --make-pidfile --pidfile "$PIDFILE" --chuid "$USER" --exec "$DAEMON" -- "$APP"
    ;;
  stop)
    start-stop-daemon --stop --quiet --retry TERM/10/KILL/5 --pidfile "$PIDFILE" --exec "$DAEMON"
    rc=$?
    rm -f "$PIDFILE"
    [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || [ "$rc" -eq 1 ]
    ;;
  restart|force-reload)
    "$0" stop
    "$0" start
    ;;
  status)
    if [ -f "$PIDFILE" ] && kill -0 "$(cat "$PIDFILE")" 2>/dev/null; then
      printf '%s is running (pid %s)\n' "$NAME" "$(cat "$PIDFILE")"
      exit 0
    fi
    printf '%s is not running\n' "$NAME"
    exit 3
    ;;
  *)
    printf 'Usage: %s {start|stop|restart|force-reload|status}\n' "$0"
    exit 1
    ;;
esac
exit 0
ANTRIEB_INIT_EOF
